entry.title: Intergenerational Transmission of Trauma in WTC Responders with PTSD

link.title: Intergenerational Transmission of Trauma in WTC Responders with PTSD

entry.content: Dr. Cycowicz discusses her evaluation of factors associated with Intergenerational Trauma among children whose parents experienced 9/11 exposure as responders. Webinar recorded on March 9, 2023.
